verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Bills API supports creating/managing vendor invoices and the Card Expenses API supports syncing to ERP/accounting systems, but there is no evidence of automatic purchase-order matching, invoice coding, or approval routing logic. AgentOS is mentioned as a toolkit for AI agents acting on the account (balances, beneficiaries, cashflow reports) but not specifically for PO-matching/invoice coding workflows. missing for 10: purchase-order matching logic, invoice coding/GL categorization, automated approval routing/workflow evidence.
